results.name: setup: white paint layer with a black left half
magic wand selects the contiguous white half
paint bucket fills the white region with the foreground colour
eyedropper sets the foreground (click) and background (Alt-click)
Filter › Blur › Gaussian Blur softens the edge with live preview and one undo step
History panel jumps to an earlier state and back
Image › Adjustments: Invert (⌘I), Levels (⌘L) and Curves cancel
Image Size resamples to 150×100 (constrained), undo restores
Image Rotation 90° clockwise moves the black half to the top
Canvas Size with a centre anchor adds space without deleting pixels
Crop tool: drag a box, Enter crops; undo restores
Rasterize a shape layer and Merge Down keep the composite identical
Clone Stamp: Alt-click a source, paint copies it
Dodge (shadows) lightens black; spot healing removes a blemish
Smudge drags black into the red half; undo restores
navigation: zoom tool click doubles the zoom, Alt-click halves it; Space-drag pans
